title: THE ASH
message: What is finished does not need to be rebuilt.
meaning:
The Ash is what remains after something has already completed its transformation.

There is nothing left to save in its original form. The card does not ask you to mourn the fire, only to notice what no longer needs to be carried forward.

Some endings become lighter once you stop treating them as unfinished.
